## Change

Describe the concrete behavior, scope and preserved behavior in English.

## Validation

Record actual commands/results and acceptance evidence. Separate local checks,
production observations and real-device results; list remaining limits.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Read [the roadmap](../docs/development_roadmap.md), task card, workflow and known constraints before starting.
- [ ] Changes stay within the task's one deliverable; unrelated findings are separate.
- [ ] Project-authored documentation and UI copy are English; the original Persian README poem is unchanged.
- [ ] UI analysis uses the existing design system and records approval when required.
- [ ] Completion evidence supports every claimed acceptance result.
